findings.rationale: The WASM check path returns an ok result for any source that passes the shallow is_ai_project heuristic, without invoking parse_ai_project. A source with a recognized first declaration and a malformed, unterminated, or duplicate project declaration can therefore be reported as successfully analyzed even though the actual project parser rejects it.

Literate materialization is keyed only by directory, stem, and process ID, then written with truncation and unconditionally removed on Drop. Reentrant or concurrent materializations of the same path within one process share a file, so one invocation can overwrite or delete the other's input; PID reuse can also overwrite and remove a stale or user-owned file at that predictable path.
